## Blockers

1. The "200" figure never appears in the body, though the frontmatter leads on it. The prose refers to the offer four times without ever stating the threshold: "the limited free food item" (:41), "the limited food-item offer" (:61), "the free food-item note" (:62), "the limited food item" (:70). Meanwhile highlights (:27) and readerImpact (:21) both carry "first 200". The prior revision had it in the body twice; commit 302da1c stripped both. Source (:972): "The first 200 people to attend each picnic can receive a free food item." The article tells readers three times to arrive early and never says what they're racing.

2. "each picnic" (:27) has no antecedent — the 12-date series is omitted entirely. The source page carries a "Picnic series schedule" table running Sat. June 13 to Thu. Aug 27, which is why the City's wording is "each picnic." The candidate frames July 30 as standalone, so the highlight reads as an error. It also drops four still-future dates that are directly useful: Aug 6 Hawthorne Rotary Park, Aug 13 Maple Green Park, Aug 20 Strawberry Hill Park, Aug 27 Guildford Heights Park. The published sibling surrey-youth-stewardship-volunteer-dates.mdx handles this correctly by listing its Aug. 11 second date.

3. "Planning notes from the official page:" (:59) attributes newsroom inference to the City. "Arrive near the start if the free food-item note matters to you" (:62) is the newsroom's advice — the page nowhere advises arriving early. "Bring your own picnic if you want more than the limited food-item offer" (:61) reframes the page's plain "Pack a picnic" into conditional advice. Reword the header to mark these as the newsroom's read, or restate what the page actually says.

## Non-blocking

- :39 "scheduled this week" replaced "Thursday, July 30" in the last commit. Accurate at publication (July 30, 2026 is a Thursday; July 27 is Monday of that week), but the relative reference decays for search arrivals and breaks house style — the sibling's lede uses "on Wednesday, July 29." Restoring the date also resolves it.
- :66 "Who is listed on site" is ambiguous between "listed on the website" and "present at the venue"; the source's framing is "Attending."

- :53 "get outdoors with friends and family... learn about City services... celebrate summer" is not in the main description field but is verbatim in the page body field (:910) and meta description (:6) — properly sourced.

- All nine partners (:68) match the source; Surrey Mobile Library appears twice in the source (City + Community partners) and is correctly deduped to one mention.
